scope: Working implementation atop this base; tested file hashes identify the relevant version. Native sample checks qualify decoding, coordinates and calibration before the separately audited quality masks. Range hashes identify only bytes actually read, never the full native product.

conversion.processing: Native cell containing each output pixel centre; original sample units retained as float32; no averaging or gap fill.

nativeChecks.method: Independent ISIS-label coordinates and byte offsets; native samples decoded by DataView. Checks source-to-compact sampling, not instrument accuracy or all native pixels.
